name: Cisco ASA — SMB Lateral Movement to Previously Unseen Internal Hosts
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter cisco_asa_raw._raw_log contains "302013" and xdm.source.port = 445
| comp count_distinct(xdm.source.ipv4) as smb_hosts,
       values(xdm.source.ipv4) as source_hosts
       by xdm.target.ipv4
| filter smb_hosts >= 5 and smb_hosts < 10
| alter initiator_ip = xdm.target.ipv4
| join type = left (
    dataset = cisco_asa_raw
    | filter _raw_log contains "722051" and _raw_log contains "assigned to session"
    | alter pool_ip = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "Address <(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)>"), 0),
            vpn_user = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "User <([^>]+)>"), 0)
    | filter pool_ip != null
    | comp values(vpn_user) as user_name by pool_ip
    | fields pool_ip, user_name
  ) as bind bind.pool_ip = initiator_ip
| fields xdm.target.ipv4, source_hosts, user_name
description: Internal host establishing SMB/445 connections to 5–9 distinct internal hosts within 15 minutes — lateral movement after VPN compromise.
alert_name: Cisco ASA — SMB Lateral Movement to Previously Unseen Internal Hosts

TA0008 - Lateral Movement: T1021.002 - Remote Services: SMB/Windows Admin Shares
